alt: The hours field is built first, then the colon, then the minutes field. A value with one digit gets a padding zero in front, drawn with its own state. A value that already has two digits is left alone. The finished text is printed.

steps.caption: `hours:02d` wants at least 2 digits. `hours` is 7, one digit, so a 0 goes in front: 07. The highlighted 0 is padding, not part of the value.

The `:` is plain text in the f-string, copied as it is. `minutes:02d` wants at least 2 digits. `minutes` is 5, one digit, so a 0 goes in front: 05. The highlighted 0 is padding, not part of the value.
`print` shows 07:05. Both numbers keep the same width, so times line up whatever the values.
`hours:02d` wants at least 2 digits. `hours` is 12, which already has 2, so nothing is added: 12.
The `:` is plain text in the f-string, copied as it is. `minutes:02d` wants at least 2 digits. `minutes` is 30, which already has 2, so nothing is added: 30.
`print` shows 12:30. Both numbers keep the same width, so times line up whatever the values.
`hours:02d` wants at least 2 digits. `hours` is 0, one digit, so a 0 goes in front: 00. The highlighted 0 is padding, not part of the value.

The `:` is plain text in the f-string, copied as it is. `minutes:02d` wants at least 2 digits. `minutes` is 0, one digit, so a 0 goes in front: 00. The highlighted 0 is padding, not part of the value.
`print` shows 00:00. Both numbers keep the same width, so times line up whatever the values.
